For a limited time, you can get all Cleverweek Games, (including DLC), for just $1.49 on Bundle Stars!

The deal is called the [url=https://www.bundlestars.com/en/bundle/swift-bundle]Swift Bundle[/url], and it will be available for 13 days from now.

[b]THIS DEAL IS ONE-TIME, AND WILL NOT RETURN ANYTIME SOON![/b]

What is more, if you buy this bundle, you can get our upcoming game for $1.40 off during launch week, for just $3.59! To claim this discount, go to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/469/]this link[/url] between Nov. 3 - Nov. 9.

Thanks, and enjoy!
The Cleverweek Team

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Hello players,
We just pushed a hotfix to Snik, which addresses the following two issues;

[list]
    [*]People unlocked 3-star achievements without actually getting three stars.
    [*]The background music stopped in the middle of the game.
[/list]

These issues are now fixed.

The Cleverweek Team

notes.title: Snik is available!
notes.notes:
We just released Snik on Steam and Android. Currently you can buy Snik on Steam at [strike]$4.99[/strike] $4.24 (15% off).

Moreover, Snik is currently 17% off on Google Play, at [strike]$2.99[/strike] $2.49. 

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cleverweek.snik

Both versions will be back at their retail prices after a week.

Also, please report any bugs you might encounter as soon as possible. We will fix it quickly.
